name: @openagt/agent-data
description: What OpenAgent's packages share about a project: making a folder a project, and where its coding-agent data lives: the person's own folder ~/.openagent by default, or a branch of the project's repository when shared, checked out under .branches/; every branch write is one sync-commit-push cycle that re-applies when it loses a race, from a long-lived process or one-shot from any clone.
